diagnosis: ser_tx stayed idle so loopback RX got 0xff vs want 0xa5, causing TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5 and tohost FAIL 0xdead. Root cause is picosoc/simpleuart.v:130 `send_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)` which makes the TX bit period 16x too short for divider 64, so the receiver samples idle and returns 0xff. Control wiring per picosoc/picosoc.v:197 reg_div_we and picosoc/picosoc.v:201 reg_dat_we confirms the divider-configured TX path; trace wins over sparse CONE_SLICE.
reason: Diagram shows TX completing early and RX sampling idle 1s to give 0xff, confirming 16x-short TX period.
